title: TCCL: Discovering Better Communication Paths for PCIe GPU Clusters
problem: PCIe-based GPU clusters lack optimized collective communication libraries, as research has focused on proprietary interconnects like DGX. Discovering efficient communication paths for ring-based algorithms on commodity PCIe systems remains unexplored.
motivation: Collective communication is critical for distributed deep learning training, and most clusters use commodity PCIe interconnects rather than proprietary solutions, making optimization of PCIe communication essential.
method: TCCL profiles multi-transfer performance with a custom profiler, discovers optimal ring-based communication paths using a pathfinder algorithm, and modifies NCCL runtime to utilize these paths. It focuses on collective operations like AllReduce and AllGather across PCIe-connected GPU clusters.
key_novelty: Automated discovery and exploitation of optimal communication paths for ring-based collective operations on PCIe GPU clusters through performance profiling and path optimization.
contributions: TCCL library with integrated profiler, pathfinder, and modified NCCL runtime for PCIe GPU clusters
Ring-based collective communication optimization achieving up to 2.07x speedup over NCCL/MSCCL
Comprehensive evaluation across multiple PCIe cluster configurations
Support for various deep learning parallelism strategies
limitations: Focus restricted to ring-based algorithms; applicability to other topologies and heterogeneous cluster configurations not discussed.
primary_theme: PCIe GPU cluster collective communication optimization
